lines.1: We headed back to the hut.
lines.2: We laid out the futons that had been stacked up.
lines.3: 「You don't have to put them that far apart.」
lines.5: I moved the futons closer together.
lines.7: 「It's hard to get the distance right.」
lines.8: I adjusted them until they were about two meters apart.
lines.10: 「This is the border. The Berlin Wall.」
lines.11: She laid a wooden stick between the futons.
lines.13: 「Don't worry. I wouldn't cross it if my life depended on it.」
lines.14: 「What should I do if you cross the border?」
lines.15: 「Ahaha! What are you talking about? That's never going to happen.」
lines.16: 「Then I'd be a border intruder. As your prisoner, you can do whatever you want.」
lines.17: 「Buuut! If you cross the border, I'll show no mercy--I'll swiftly and coldly go straight for your eyes with this stick.」
lines.18: 「...Yikes. I'll be sure to keep that in mind.」
lines.19: 「And don't think an excuse like "I hugged you because of my bad sleeping habits" will work!」
lines.25: I couldn't help feeling a little nervous.
lines.29: I was tired, too, and gradually began to drift off.
